gauge_comment: Training cameras are image-estimated COLMAP poses, already aligned upstream by one global Sim(3) to fix coordinate gauge. Ground truth is used for that global gauge and held-out evaluation only; no per-camera GT training pose is read or substituted by this script. This is a gauge-aligned SfM-to-NeRF experiment, not a completely uncalibrated capture experiment.
comparison_limitation: All original training views registered; comparison primarily measures estimated-camera effects
